spans.s: मकरन्द् (1)name of a commentary by Raṅganātha on the Padamañjari of Haradatta; (2) name of a commentary on the Supadma Vyākaraṇa by Viṣṇumiśra.
मकार the consonant म् with the vowel अ and the affix कार added for facility of use and pronunciation; cf. T.Pr.
माक्षव्य name of an ancient writer of Praatisakhya works mentioned in the Rk Praatisakhya: cf. R. Pr.

मक्डोनल् [MACDONELL,ARTHUR ANTHONY ] a deep scholar of Vedic Gram. and Literature who has written an exhaustive Vedic Grammar; in treatment, at places he differs from Paanini and follows a different method, but the manner of thinking and argument is on original lines.
